title: Reduce Completed secondary helper exports
summary: Removed six transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed secondary helper functions while preserving the same functions on window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue the namespace-first WebView cleanup stream with a scoped Completed-domain change that avoids aliases still used by app.js, commandHistory.js, Pending Publish, Diagnostics, or browser smokes.
behavior_before: Completed helpers resetCompletedHistoryFilters, renderCompletedDetail, completedReviewStatus, completedReviewBoardLines, completedPilotEvidencePacketSummaryLines, and completedCurrentFilterScope were available through both window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and direct window.* flat aliases.
behavior_after: Those helpers remain available through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and internal dependency injection, while their direct flat aliases are removed. Compatibility aliases that still have direct callers remain untouched.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require the removed helper names through mediaPipelineCompletedView and to assert the served Completed source no longer assigns those flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the six direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
